mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 2 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the combination signals a high inflation environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month, combined with a decrease in UNRATE, signals a strong labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and UNRATE decreases and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 2 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% YoY and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 3% YoY, it signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% and GDPC1 YoY > 3% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
